assets.gate_reason: S17: the Solipsist Dreamscape plane's zone-local CLOUD floor (animated cloud_anim shader natively) has no board picture; user-approved new cloud-floor family. One opaque cloud-floor master; the exporter adds 3 windows x 16 cloud-edge masks x 2 parities. Rules unchanged (walkable, no callback). No waiver.
assets.scope: Zone-local CLOUD (dreamscape-talent/grids.lua) of the Dreamscape talent plane only: every walkable cell of the 20x20 plane; its void is OUTERSPACE (separate master).

references.note: Native dreamscape floor: one soft white billowing cloud puff with pale blue shading. Keep the soft white cloud identity, but as a continuous flat walkable surface filling the whole square, not a single puff on a dark background.

Accepted board stone floor master: flat overhead matte printed-board finish, upper-left light, broad low-contrast variation and texture scale. Not its sandstone palette, stone grain or its value; the cloud floor is lighter and softer.

grid_contract.movement: Walkable floor; no movement rule, no speed bonus or penalty.
grid_contract.danger: None: no callback, no damage. Must not look like ice, snow drift, water, a pit or a trap.
grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed material; the exporter crops 3 windows and 2 checker parities and adds a soft cloud rim only where a neighbour is not cloud (16 masks), no wall, rail or fence.

prompt_fields.subject: A walkable dream floor made of dense, packed cloud seen from straight above: a soft continuous surface of rounded, gently overlapping cloud billows pressed flat into one level, like a quilted pillowy ground you could stand on; faint soft hollows between billows, no holes and no gaps.
prompt_fields.palette: Pearl white and very pale lavender-grey billow tops with soft cool blue-grey and faint lilac shading in the hollows; a light, mid-high value overall (clearly lighter than a board stone floor) but not blown-out pure white, so the shading still reads at small size.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as soft solid ground to stand on: about three to four billows across the square, broad and low-contrast, even and non-directional, so it does NOT read as snow with footprints, ice, foam on water, smoke, a pit or a wall, and so creature tokens stay the strongest element on it.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead floor material filling the whole square; billows of even size distributed uniformly, reaching all four edges; no border, rim, edge drop, sky, gap, hole, object, rune, symbol, vortex, glow spot or cast shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Plain walkable floor with no effect. Paint no void, hole, edge, pit, stairs, portal, character, warning sign, symbol or text.
